notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Here it is - new update for the demo! 

Thanks everyone for your feedback! In this update we've made the following improvements and changes:

[h2]Patch Notes: Demo Update #1[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed 'Smash Attack' to trigger on second consecutive melee attack
[*] Moved the shop to after the assault rifle to improve level flow
[*] Added DLSS profile settings
[*] Added HDR setting
[*] Improved GPU performance
[*] Several minor fixes
[/list]
[h3][b]Join the Discord[/b][/h3]
Try out the new update and let us know what you think of the demo! Please share any feedback or any bugs with us our [url=https://discord.gg/FujpKaVJpG][b]Discord[/b][/url].

notes.title: Akimbot | Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
ALL RIGHT. LET'S DO THIS. 

[h2]AKIMBOT IS LANDING AUGUST 29 🚀💫[/h2]

Get a glimpse of robots, action, and adventure in an all new trailer!

[previewyoutube=Q-WyWKzHC2M;full][/previewyoutube]
In Akimbot, you'll play as Exe, an outlaw robot with his unexpected sidekick, Shipset. Blast your way through armies of robots, control spaceships, and forge your own path on a mission to save the universe from impending doom! Set in a sci-fi world where only robots exist, travel the galaxy and experience non-stop robot mayhem and explosive action!
